dedupe_keys.name: rmp comp offsite consequence analysis tool epa

description: RMP*Comp is a free EPA program for completing the offsite consequence analyses that facilities must report under the Clean Air Act Risk Management Program rule, covering both worst-case release scenarios and alternative, more likely scenarios. It guides the user through the analysis so that no calculations are done by hand, and it runs in a web browser such as Firefox, Chrome or Safari. It is provided by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, whose RMP Reporting Center answers technical questions; the page was last updated on 20 April 2026. Coverage is national: it serves US facilities holding regulated toxic or flammable substances above threshold quantities, such as chemical plants, refineries and water treatment works. The tool is available free online with no registration stated. Caveats: it applies the simplified methods of the RMP guidance, and EPA points to NOAA's ALOHA as the other appropriate tool while noting that CAMEO is not suited to RMP consequence analysis. For simulation it gives screening estimates of how far a chemical release could reach, useful for hazard exposure mapping around plants and for emergency response planning around critical infrastructure. It is related to the EPA Risk Management Plan information and ALOHA records in this catalogue.
